method: npm pack from the frozen tree into a disposable destination
extract the tarball into a disposable local opencode plugin directory
npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts in the extracted directory
write an isolated opencode config listing only that local directory
link the owner Muse auth file into the isolated config without reading it
run opencode with --standalone and a disposable HOME/XDG root
